repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Scope note from the seat (read-only check of the file at `origin/main`, nothing run). The fix is wider than one line:

- Cause: `MasterDetailForm.tsx` draws each section's heading before its columns load, so headings can exist while a grid is still on "Loading columns…". `gridOf` (about line 203) returns `gridProps.slice(-sections)[index]`, which is `undefined` until every section's grid has been captured.
- Case 1 makes two bare reads after the heading wait (about lines 259 and 262). Both assertions belong inside `waitFor`.
- The same latent pattern (wait on the first section, then read later sections bare) sits at about lines 370, 393, 399 and 496.
- `slice(-sections)` assumes whole render passes, and a single-grid re-render misaligns it. A lookup keyed by section title (or by the captured `field.name`) is sturdier than the index.
- The sibling `*Members-8071` files do not define or use `gridOf`/`gridProps`, so they are not affected.

It is now red on three open PRs that do not touch plugin-form: #36437 (Test UI 12/16), #36438 (2/16) and #36461 (14/16).
